summary: Synchrony Financial filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of 500,000 depositary shares, each representing a 1/100th interest in a share of 7.250% Fixed Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series C, with a liquidation preference of $1,000 per depositary share. The public offering price is $1,000 per depositary share, total $500 million, with underwriting discount of $10 per share. Dividends are non-cumulative, payable quarterly at 7.250% until August 15, 2031, then reset based on Five-Year U.S. Treasury Rate plus 3.078%. Redemption is at the issuer's option on or after the first reset date at $100,000 per preferred share plus declared and unpaid dividends. The shares are not listed on any exchange. There is no special-situation event; this is an ordinary preferred stock takedown.
